description:
unclone/wots-sha256/w16/h8/v2.
WOTS w=16 over SHA-256, under a Merkle tree of height 8.

ADRS = u32be(type) | u32be(leaf) | u32be(chain) | u32be(step) | 16 zero bytes.
  type 0 = chain step, 1 = secret, 2 = tree leaf, 3 = tree node.
F(pubSeed, ADRS, x) = SHA-256(pubSeed || ADRS || x).
sk_i  = SHA-256(skSeed || ADRS(1, leaf, i, 0)).
pk_i  = sk_i walked 15 steps, step s applying F(pubSeed, ADRS(0, leaf, i, s), .).
publicKey = pk_0 || ... || pk_66  (67 x 32 bytes).

steps(digest): for each of the 32 digest bytes emit the high nibble then
  the low nibble (64 values), then a checksum of sum(15 - d) over those,
  as 3 base-16 digits, most significant first. 67 values in total.
sigma_i = sk_i walked d_i steps. Verify by walking sigma_i a further
  (15 - d_i) steps and comparing with pk_i.

leafHash  = SHA-256(ADRS(2, leaf, 0, 0) || publicKey).
nodeHash  = SHA-256(ADRS(3, 0, height, index) || left || right).
root      = the 8-level climb over 256 leaves.

digest    = SHA-256("unclone/wots-sha256/w16/h8/v2" || u32be(leaf) || message).
  The scheme id and the leaf are bound in, so a signature cannot be
  replayed under another scheme or at another leaf.

attestations.message: the last leaf there will ever be

mustFail.note: A correct implementation REFUSES this. A verifier that accepts it accepts anything.
